note: Cleanup (整音) policy, docs/SPEC.md 6.4. Band policy, detector thresholds and verification limits. Every numeric value is an initial value subject to calibration (SPEC 4.3, 4.9) unless marked otherwise. Reference point: the published approach of Spectral-Lifter (MIT) -- low band untouched, detection-based reduction in the high band, optional high-frequency completion; implemented independently. Neural completion is not part of the standard path (D-041).

frequency_hz.note: Low-band protection boundary. At and below this frequency the output equals the input (S-07). Implemented as a zero-phase complementary split of the removed component: gain exactly 0 at and below the boundary.

transition_hz.note: Width of the raised-cosine transition above the boundary in which the removed component is faded in.

window_s.note: Hann analysis/synthesis window length; rounded up to a power of two (2048 at 44.1/48 kHz, 4096 at 88.2/96 kHz).

overlap.note: Window length / hop. 4 = 75 % overlap (Hann^2 sums to a constant).

bands.note: Never changed; spliced back from the input and verified by the null test (S-07).
Lead clarity band. Reduced only where the artifact detector fires strongly; small caps.
Sibilance/breath band. Protection caps the reduction during detected sibilant events.
Shimmer band. Detection-based reduction of 3-6 dB per pass over several passes.
14 kHz up to the HF ceiling (or Nyquist). Detection-based, with a minimum reduction wherever the detector fires.
Only when an HF ceiling is detected: everything above it is treated as artifact candidates.

group_hz.note: STFT bins are pooled into groups of about this width for detection.

freq_smooth_groups.note: Frequency smoothing of pooled power before the temporal reference (reduces periodogram variance).

ref_window_s.note: Length of each temporal window (before and after the frame) for the steady reference.

ref_percentile.note: Percentile of the window used as the steady (non-flickering) reference level.

slope.note: dB of reduction per dB of excess above the threshold (before the per-pass cap).

gain_smooth_frames.note: Temporal smoothing of the reduction (anti musical noise).

gain_smooth_groups.note: Frequency smoothing of the reduction (anti musical noise).

band_hz.note: Band whose energy jump marks a musical transient (below the shimmer band, so shimmer flicker does not open the gate).

pre_frames.note: Frames before the detected onset frame that are also protected (window pre-echo).

release_s.note: Protection then fades out linearly over this time (transient-onset release control).

comod_db.note: Excess of the onset band over its own steady reference mapped to protection 0..1: the high band is following a short musical event (hi-hat, snare, consonant).

highpass_hz.note: Sharp attacks are looked for in the high-passed mid signal.

lookback_ms.note: The block RMS is compared with the quietest block this far before it.

near_max_db.note: The block must reach within this of the local maximum (+-local_ms/2): a real hit, not a wiggle at the bottom of a tremolo.

prominence_db.note: A bin is a spectral peak if it is a local maximum this far above the local frequency mean.

continuity_frames.note: A peak that persists (within +-1 bin) for this many frames is a tracked partial and is never attenuated.

density_ratio_db.note: Per-bin power density of the sibilant band relative to the reference band at or above which a frame can be sibilant.

level_above_floor_db.note: Band level above its 20th percentile needed to count as an event.

cap_db.note: Maximum total reduction inside the sibilant band during sibilant events (keeps > 93 % of the energy).

upper_cap_db.note: Cap above the sibilant band (up to upper_cap_hz) during sibilant events.

band_hz.note: Breath and cymbal events: noise-like energy in this band.

cap_db.note: Maximum total reduction in any band during breath/cymbal events.

highpass_hz.note: Detection runs on the 4th-order Butterworth high-passed signal (derivative-like emphasis of click energy).

peak_ratio.note: Block peak relative to the local median block peak.

isolation_ratio.note: Blocks 6-12 ms before and after must stay below this times the local median (a click is short; a drum hit is not).

isolation_drop.note: ... and below this fraction of the candidate block peak (rejects slowly decaying hits).

extent_ratio.note: Click extent: samples around the peak whose high-passed magnitude exceeds this times the local level.

context_ms.note: Context on each side for the least-squares cubic bridge. At the very start, the context before the file is taken as silence.

head_s.note: Clicks within this time from the start set the head-click flag.

full_band_min_hz.note: A ceiling at or above this is reported as full band (None).

drop_db.note: Level just below minus the 95th percentile of everything above must reach this.

edge_db.note: Reported ceiling = first frequency where the LTAS is this far below the level just below.

min_content_db.note: The level below the ceiling must be within this of the LTAS maximum (excludes naturally band-limited stems).

auto_enable_on_ceiling.note: Completion is optional (SPEC 6.4.2 step 5). The plan proposes it as an alternative; it runs only when the plan enables it.

method.note: Deterministic DSP (half-wave rectification of the band below the ceiling). 'neural' is refused unless explicitly enabled with a registry model (D-041).

fit_window_hz.note: LTAS slope is fitted over [ceiling - 4000, ceiling - 300] and extrapolated.

margin_db.note: Generated band sits this far below the extrapolated slope (low level).

shimmer_run_db.note: Shimmer index (flicker excess in 10-14 kHz relative to 1-8 kHz energy) at or above which spectral reduction runs.

side_hf_excess_db.note: Side/mid ratio in 10-16 kHz minus side/mid ratio in 1-8 kHz above which side artifacts are flagged.

side_hf_min_level_db.note: Side HF level (relative to mid 1-8 kHz) below which the side excess is ignored.

above_ceiling_run_db.note: Flicker excess above the ceiling relative to 1-8 kHz energy.

above_ceiling_min_level_db.note: Mean level above the ceiling relative to just below it; below this there is nothing worth removing.

noise_floor_percentile.note: Quiet passages = the lowest percentile of 400 ms frames (digital silence excluded).

residual_limit_dbfs.note: Peak of (output - input) after a brick-wall low-pass at the crossover. Initial value based on prior-implementation measurements (SPEC 4.3).

shimmer_index_tol_db.note: Allowed rise of the shimmer index after mastering (gain-invariant ratio).

noise_floor_tol_db.note: Allowed rise of the quiet-passage noise floor after compensating the master's gain change.

width_tol_db.note: Max narrowing of the side ratio S/(M+S) per band, in dB.

min_band_energy_db.note: Bands below this energy (relative to full scale) are not judged.

corr_threshold.note: Correlation between the 5-8 kHz envelope of the removed component and of the input above which the cleanup is suspected of eating sibilants/breaths.

min_removed_db.note: Removed 5-8 kHz energy during sibilant frames relative to the input; below this the correlation is ignored.

strength_factor.note: Strength multiplier for the single automatic rerun.
